description: Compute UTC start and end times of golden hour (solar elevation -4° to +6°), blue hour (-6° to -4°) and conventional sunrise and sunset (-0.833°) for one UTC day at a latitude and longitude, 1900–2100. Purely geometric: no refraction, terrain or weather. Numerical tolerance is not astronomical accuracy.

date_utc.description: Real Gregorian UTC midnight, year 1900–2100. Rust also validates month/day and leap years. Other hours are rejected, never truncated; this is not a local civil day.

name: plan_golden_hour
title: Golden and blue hour windows
